name: Qualitee
author: qualitee

sections.description:
This plugin is exclusively for Qualitee SaaS users.

Qualitee is an AI-powered content generation platform that creates high-quality articles for your business. This official WordPress plugin allows you to seamlessly connect your WordPress website to your Qualitee account, enabling automatic publishing of AI-generated articles directly to your site.

How it works:

  1. Install this plugin on your WordPress site
  2. Get your connection token from the plugin settings
  3. Add your WordPress site to your Qualitee account using the token
  4. Generate articles in your Qualitee dashboard
  5. Publish automatically – articles appear on your WordPress site instantly

For Qualitee SaaS users only:

This plugin requires an active Qualitee SaaS subscription. If you don’t have a Qualitee account yet, visit qualitee.io to start your free trial and experience AI-powered content generation.

Key Features:

  • Secure Connection – Token-based authentication between Qualitee and your WordPress site
  • Automatic Publishing – Articles generated in Qualitee appear instantly on your WordPress site
  • Smart Image Handling – AI-generated images are automatically downloaded and optimized
  • SEO Optimized – Articles include proper meta tags, categories, and formatting
  • Multiple Authors – Support for different author assignments from your Qualitee campaigns
  • Scheduled Publishing – Set publication times directly from your Qualitee dashboard

Perfect for:

  • Businesses using Qualitee for content marketing
  • Agencies managing multiple client WordPress sites
  • Content creators who want to automate their publishing workflow
  • Anyone with a Qualitee SaaS subscription who wants WordPress integration

Support

For Qualitee SaaS users:
– Visit your Qualitee account dashboard for account-related support
– Check our documentation for setup guides
– Contact Qualitee support through your account dashboard

For WordPress-specific issues:
– Visit our support forum

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect or store personal data. It only facilitates secure communication between your WordPress site and your Qualitee account. All content and data handling follows WordPress and Qualitee privacy standards.

The plugin creates a secure token that allows your Qualitee account to publish articles to your WordPress site. This token is stored locally in your WordPress database and is not shared with any third parties.
sections.installation:
Requirements:
– WordPress 5.7 or higher
– PHP 7.4 or higher
– An active Qualitee SaaS subscription

Installation Steps:

  1. Install this plugin on your WordPress site (either via WordPress admin or manual upload)
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to your WordPress admin → Qualitee
  4. Copy the API token displayed
  5. Log in to your Qualitee account at app.qualitee.io
  6. Add your WordPress site using the token
  7. Start generating and publishing articles!
sections.faq:
Do I need a Qualitee account to use this plugin?

Yes, this plugin is exclusively for Qualitee SaaS users. You need an active Qualitee subscription to use this plugin. Visit qualitee.io to sign up.

How do I connect my WordPress site to Qualitee?

After installing the plugin, go to WordPress admin → Qualitee to get your connection token. Then add your WordPress site in your Qualitee account dashboard using this token.

What happens when I generate an article in Qualitee?

When you generate and publish an article in your Qualitee dashboard, it will automatically appear on your connected WordPress site with proper formatting, images, and SEO optimization.

Can I connect multiple WordPress sites?

Yes! Each WordPress site will have its own unique token. You can add multiple sites to your Qualitee account and manage them all from one dashboard.

Is this plugin free?

The plugin itself is free, but it requires an active Qualitee SaaS subscription to function. Qualitee offers various subscription plans to fit different needs.

What if I cancel my Qualitee subscription?

If you cancel your Qualitee subscription, the plugin will no longer receive new articles, but any articles already published on your WordPress site will remain.

Can I still create posts manually in WordPress?

Absolutely! This plugin only adds functionality – it doesn’t interfere with your normal WordPress posting workflow.
